body.name: Tail-box compactification of the conditional nuisance region
body.construction: On \(\mathcal B_{G,R}\), enumerate endpoint orders and active simplex faces, replace every face offset larger than \(2G/\lambda\) by that cap, preserve each known within-cell offset pattern, and cap successive shared-noise-group translation gaps at \(2R+2K_\eta\); the resulting finite union is \(\Gamma_\eta^{G,R}\).
